title: Fluency: Ya-Sin 1 to 44: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 26 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Fluency rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 26. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Theme
rows: The town, the messengers, the believing man
Signs: earth, night, sun, moon, ships

arabic.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ (٣٣) وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ (٣٤) لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ (٣٥) سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ (٣٦) وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ (٣٧) وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ (٣٨)

questions.q: Chain recitation: 36:33 to 44, one ayah each.
Fluency rota: today's group recites a section chosen at random. Everyone else: 3-3-link their weakest section.
Extend: time a section recited at tadwir pace with all rules kept.
questions.a: A time written in the log.

questions.q: Which section tells of the man who came running?
questions.a: A) 36:13 to 32. 36:20 is in the story of the town.

questions.q: Think again: Fluency is not speed. What is it?
questions.a: Smooth, steady recitation with no hesitations, rules kept, sensible stops.
